xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition:
The composition and functions of Board of Directors of the Bank and its sub-committees are governed by the provisions of BCATU Act 1970, BR Act 1949 & Nationalized Banks Scheme, 1970, RBI / GOI Guidelines. However, Bank complies with the Corporate Governance requirements of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 to the extent applicable.
Because of insufficient number of Independent Directors on the board of the Bank, Bank does not have sufficient number of directors to constitute the ACB, RMC and NRC. Therefore, Bank has invoked 14A of Nationalized Banks (Management & Miscellanoeus Provisions) Act, 1970 and kept the agendas of the said committees before Board.
Bank will nominate members in Audit Committee of the Board, Nomination and Remuneration Committee and Risk Manangement Committee and appoint a regular chairperson in Audit Committee and Risk Management Committee, once more Directors are appointed by GOI on Board
